verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or invoicing workflows is a fair question for an invoicing product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no user-defined recurring schedules. The closest item is Stripe's automatic reminders and payment retries on overdue or failed invoices, which are event-triggered collection behavior rather than a recurring job or workflow schedule. The docs also frame the product around one-time payments, with automation limited to collection and reconciliation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
